name: Web Page Reader
description: Open and read a link you share.
abilities: Opens a link you give and reads the page
Follows links from search results to the source itself
permissions: Fetches public pages over HTTPS from Dyadic's servers
After reading outside content, only opens links from you or from earlier results

changes.notes: Now a plugin in the Store, on for everyone. Turn it off here when you don't want it.
